# LLM Gateway

> OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible HTTP gateway in front of the Vilao and CKey LLM marketplaces.
> Routes each request to the best seller listing, falls back on failure, and reports cost in VND.

- Base URL (OpenAI SDKs): http://HOST:3000/v1
- Base URL (Anthropic SDKs, Claude Code): http://HOST:3000
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer gw-...` or `x-api-key: gw-...` (gateway-issued key)
- The `model` field is a POOL NAME. Discover pools with GET /v1/models (owned_by == "gateway").

## Docs

- [API reference](/docs): every endpoint, real request/response examples, error codes, routing behaviour
- [OpenAPI 3.1](/openapi.yaml): machine-readable schema

## Management (admin key only)

- /api/catalog (search listings), /api/catalog/sync, /api/pools (CRUD), /api/pools/:name/members,
  /api/pools/:name/verify (spends money), /api/usage, /api/reconcile, /api/keys
- Ordinary gw- keys get 403 on /api/*. See "Management API" in /docs.

## Key facts

- Endpoints: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/embeddings, /v1/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/moderations, /v1/rerank, /v1/models
- Every `usage` object gains `cost`, `cost_currency: "VND"`, `cost_source: upstream|estimated|floor`
- Response headers: X-Gateway-Pool, X-Gateway-Listing, X-Gateway-Attempts
- Streaming: usage arrives in a frame with `"choices": []`; end on `[DONE]` / `message_stop`
- 404 is retried across sellers; 400/401/413/422 are not
- Set client timeout >= 120s
